# Finish Demo

This runbook demonstrates the `<Finish>` block, which marks the end of a runbook.

When you click **Finish**, it runs an optional final check. If the check passes, the runbook is finished: the block celebrates with confetti and shows the next steps. If it fails, fix the problem and click **Finish** again.

## 1. Set Up

This block exports `DEMO_READY=true`. The environment carries forward to later blocks, so the final check below can see it.

<Command
    id="setup"
    command="export DEMO_READY=true && echo 'Setup complete.'"
    title="Get ready to finish"
    successMessage="Ready!"
/>

## 2. Finish

The final check passes only once the setup block has run. Try clicking **Finish** before running it to see a failed check.

<Finish
    id="finish"
    command='test "$DEMO_READY" = true'
    description="Checks that the setup block has run."
>

### Next steps

- Read the [`<Finish>` docs](https://runbooks.gruntwork.io/authoring/blocks/finish/) to add one to your own runbook.
- Leave out `command` and `path` for a Finish with no final check: clicking it finishes the runbook straight away.

</Finish>
